```{r}
lambda <- matrix(c(0.8,0.1, 0.7,0.2, 0.9,0.1, 0.8,0,
                    0.1,0.8, 0.2,0.7, 0.1,0.9, 0,0.8),
                  ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
cov_f <- matrix(c(1,0.6,0.6,1), nrow = 2)
cov_e <- diag(8)

cov_pop <- lambda %*% cov_f %*% t(lambda) + cov_e
cov_pop
```
```{r}
# install this package if you haven't used it before
library(mvtnorm) 
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

set.seed(2026)
n <- 500
factors <- rmvnorm(n = n, mean = c(0, 0),
                   sigma = cov_f)
errors <- rmvnorm(n = n, mean = rep(0, 8),
                   sigma = cov_e)

y <- factors %*% t(lambda) + errors
y <- as.data.frame(y)
y
```
```{r}
# sample covariance
sample_cov <- cov(y)

# comparison
round(sample_cov - cov_pop, 3)
```

```{r}
fa_no <- factanal(y, factors = 2, rotation = "none")
fa_var <- factanal(y, factors = 2, rotation = "varimax")
fa_pro  <- factanal(y, factors = 2, rotation = "promax")

print(fa_no, digits = 3, cutoff = 0)
print(fa_var, digits = 3, cutoff = 0)
print(fa_pro,  digits = 3, cutoff = 0)
```
```{r}
# A function to extract factor loadings and covert it to a tibble
loading_df <- function(obj, rotation) {
  # arguments:
  # obj: The fitted factor object
  # rotation: name of the rotation used
  obj$loadings |>  
  unclass() |> 
  as.data.frame() |> 
  rownames_to_column() |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(rotation = rotation)
}
```

```{r}
# combine all three fits into one tibble
loadings_all <- bind_rows(
  loading_df(fa_no,    "None"),
  loading_df(fa_var, "Varimax"),
  loading_df(fa_pro,  "Promax")
) |>
  rename(variable = rowname) |>
  mutate(rotation = factor(rotation, levels = c("None", "Varimax", "Promax")))

# scatter plot: Factor1 vs Factor2, faceted by rotation
ggplot(loadings_all, aes(x = Factor1, y = Factor2, label = variable)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 2, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ rotation) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-0.5, 1), ylim = c(-0.5, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Estimated factor loadings under three rotations (r = 2)",
       x = "Loading on Factor 1", y = "Loading on Factor 2") +
  theme_bw()

```
